sql: SELECT TOP 10 c.CategoryCode AS categoryCode, c.ZnodeCategoryId AS categoryId, c.Name AS name, CONCAT(@routePrefix, c.ZnodeCategoryId) AS route, pr.productCount AS productCount, COUNT(k.childId) AS subcategoryCount, MAX(CASE WHEN k.position = @pos1 THEN k.childId END) AS subcategory1Id, MAX(CASE WHEN k.position = @pos1 THEN k.childName END) AS subcategory1Name, MAX(CASE WHEN k.position = @pos2 THEN k.childId END) AS subcategory2Id, MAX(CASE WHEN k.position = @pos2 THEN k.childName END) AS subcategory2Name, MAX(CASE WHEN k.position = @pos3 THEN k.childId END) AS subcategory3Id, MAX(CASE WHEN k.position = @pos3 THEN k.childName END) AS subcategory3Name, MAX(CASE WHEN k.position = @pos4 THEN k.childId END) AS subcategory4Id, MAX(CASE WHEN k.position = @pos4 THEN k.childName END) AS subcategory4Name, MAX(d.shortDescription) AS shortDescription, MAX(d.longDescription) AS longDescription FROM dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity c INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity v ON v.VersionId = c.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = c.ZnodeCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal p ON p.PortalId = pc.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h ON h.PimCategoryHierarchyId = c.ZnodeCategoryId INNER JOIN (SELECT ph.PimCategoryHierarchyId AS categoryId, pe.VersionId AS versionId, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.ZnodeProductId) AS productCount FROM dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy ph INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct cp ON cp.PimCategoryId = ph.PimCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe ON pe.ZnodeProductId = cp.PimProductId WHERE cp.Status = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, ph.PimCategoryHierarchyId, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, pe.ZnodeCategoryIds, @comma)) > @zero GROUP BY ph.PimCategoryHierarchyId, pe.VersionId) pr ON pr.categoryId = c.ZnodeCategoryId AND pr.versionId = c.VersionId LEFT JOIN (SELECT ch.ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId AS parentId, cc.VersionId AS versionId, cc.ZnodeCategoryId AS childId, cc.Name AS childName, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ch.ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId, cc.VersionId ORDER BY cc.DisplayOrder, cc.ZnodeCategoryId) AS position FROM dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy ch INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity cc ON cc.ZnodeCategoryId = ch.PimCategoryHierarchyId WHERE cc.IsActive = @isActive) k ON k.parentId = c.ZnodeCategoryId AND k.versionId = c.VersionId LEFT JOIN (SELECT av.PimCategoryId AS pimCategoryId, MAX(CASE WHEN a.AttributeCode = @shortDescriptionCode THEN al.CategoryValue END) AS shortDescription, MAX(CASE WHEN a.AttributeCode = @longDescriptionCode THEN al.CategoryValue END) AS longDescription FROM dbo.ZnodePimCategoryAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute a ON a.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryAttributeValueLocale al ON al.PimCategoryAttributeValueId = av.PimCategoryAttributeValueId WHERE al.LocaleId = @localeId GROUP BY av.PimCategoryId) d ON d.pimCategoryId = h.PimCategoryId WHERE v.RevisionType = @revisionType AND v.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND v.LocaleId = @localeId AND c.IsActive = @isActive AND p.StoreCode = @store AND (c.ActivationDate IS NULL OR c.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (c.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR c.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND pr.productCount >= @minProducts AND (@maxProducts IS NULL OR pr.productCount <= @maxProducts) AND (@topLevel IS NULL OR c.ZnodeParentCategoryIds IS NULL) AND (@withDescriptions IS NULL OR (d.shortDescription IS NOT NULL AND d.longDescription IS NOT NULL)) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR c.CategoryCode = @preferred) GROUP BY c.ZnodeCategoryId, c.CategoryCode, c.Name, c.DisplayOrder, pr.productCount HAVING (@minSubcategories IS NULL OR COUNT(k.childId) >= @minSubcategories) ORDER BY c.DisplayOrder, c.ZnodeCategoryId
